thread.title: Therapy Dogs Help Students Cope with Trauma
thread.title_full: Therapy Dogs Help Students Cope with Trauma

author: MORIAH BALINGIT of The Associated Press and ANDY STEINER of MinnPost
title: Therapy Dogs Help Students Cope with Trauma
text:
• A therapy dog program at a Minnesota school helps students cope with trauma.
• Social worker Nicole Herje interacts with students and the therapy dog Sage.
• The program aims to help students who have experienced trauma.
• Over 100,000 children experience trauma annually.
• The program, "Therapy Dogs," is in Columbia Heights, Minnesota.
• Therapy dogs provide comfort to students.
• Students share their experiences and feelings with the dogs.
• The dogs are trained to interact with students.
• The program is part of a larger effort to support students' mental health.
• The article mentions the story of a student, who lost her father and found comfort in the therapy dog.
• The program is supported by the school district and community.
• The program has been successful in helping students cope with trauma.
